text:
mia: Quick sweep — heads up that the changelog cutoff for the SDK/docs/quickstarts is EOD Wednesday (PST). I noticed a couple of sample apps still reference the old auth flow. Who's owning the samplepack updates?

raj: I can take the samplepack code changes (auth bits) — should be small. need docs PRs to land before I cut the release branch though.

sophie: Docs can pick up the tutorial edits. If raj posts the PRs by tomorrow 11:00am PST I can update the quickstarts and the howto pages before cutoff. :+1:

mike: FYI, SDK pipeline needs: 1) changelog entry in CHANGELOG.md 2) package version bump in package.json 3) green CI. I can do the release branch cut once those are present. Can someone add a WIP changelog line?

raj: adding a short changelog blurb now: "fix(auth): update sample apps to new auth flow (token introspection)" — pushing a draft PR in 5.

devexp-bot: CI status for raj/samplepack-auth-draft -> checks queued...

ana: @sophie quick question — do the docs changes need new images? if yes, we might need extra time for screenshots.

sophie: @ana I checked — auth flows use same screenshots, just updated terminal commands and snippets. no new images needed.

alex: small heads up from eng-ml: the model-card wording changed last night and one sample references the old model name. i can open a tiny PR to rename the example to the latest model identifier. should be < 30m.

mike: perfect — once raj and alex PRs are merged and docs PR is opened, i'll add the changelog entry to the SDK repo and run the cut. planning canary deploy to beta org after cut (no prod pushes until next day).

mia: ownership recap: raj (samplepack code), alex (model rename), sophie (docs edits), mike (release cut + changelog), mia (final smoke). timeline: PRs by tomorrow 11:00am PST, merge by 3:00pm PST, cut at 4:00pm PST. if anyone can't meet that, flag now.

raj: on it, ping me if I miss something.

sophie: will do.

alex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/samplepack/pull/482 — tiny rename, CI passing.

devexp-bot: CI passed for PR #482.

mike: changelog draft added to sdk/CHANGELOG.md in my branch. ready to merge after docs PR lands.

mia: awesome — i'll run the smoke tests post-cut and report back in this thread. thanks y'all :rocket:

raj: :shipit:
